note: Effects that need the person cutout (Apple Vision), so they are Mac only for now. For the other session to merge into catalog.py as macOnly: True on these ids (then python3 build.py). On Windows they still render: engine/lib/no-cutout.mjs draws a version that needs no cutout, described in onWindows. Written 21 Oct 2026 from catalog.py; any new effect that puts the person in front of something belongs here too.

effects.name: Hook behind your head
effects.onWindows: The hook sits on top of the shot instead of behind your head.

effects.name: Giant word behind your head
effects.onWindows: The giant word is drawn in front of you.

effects.name: Serif numbers
effects.onWindows: The numbers are drawn in front of you.

effects.name: Glass type
effects.onWindows: The glass word is drawn over the shot.

effects.name: Magazine cover
effects.onWindows: The masthead and cover lines are drawn over the shot.

effects.name: Paper cut
effects.onWindows: Shown as a full-screen paper title card, without the white outline around you.

effects.name: Colour title
effects.onWindows: Shown as a full-screen colour title card for the same seconds; your voice carries on underneath.

effects.name: Screen behind you
effects.onWindows: Becomes a stacked shot: the screenshot or b-roll on the top half, you moved down underneath it.

effects.name: Photo fan
effects.onWindows: The photos are drawn in front of you.

effects.name: Camera snaps
effects.onWindows: The photos are drawn in front of you.

effects.name: Photo wall
effects.onWindows: The photos are drawn in front of you.

effects.name: Headline scatter
effects.onWindows: The headlines are drawn in front of you.

effects.name: Orbit
effects.onWindows: The cards circle over the shot rather than passing behind you.

effects.name: App background
effects.onWindows: Becomes the prompt bar over your shot, with the same typing.

effects.name: Frame break
effects.onWindows: The frame shrinks with you inside it; you do not step out of the frame.

effects.name: Pull-back reveal
effects.onWindows: The whole shot pulls back, you included.

effects.name: Doodle outline
effects.onWindows: The doodles wobble around you, without the white outline.

effects.name: Vertigo
effects.onWindows: The whole shot zooms; you do not hold still while the room moves.

effects.name: Headline wrap
effects.onWindows: All the lines are drawn in front of you, none tuck behind your head.

alsoMacOnly.sticker cut: A sticker with "cut": true uses the photo as it is on Windows, uncut.
alsoMacOnly.face box: The quality check finds the face with Apple Vision. On Windows it checks text and b-roll against a fixed face zone and warns instead of failing, so look at the contact sheet for anything over the face.
